title: Misty's Blossom Carpet
markdown:
It was a lovely slow afternoon in the garden. Misty the gentle kitty, with fur as soft as dandelion fluff, twitched her delicate whiskers. The grass felt a little tickly, not quite plump enough for a long lovely snooze. She felt a warm heaviness behind her eyes, wanting a truly special nap spot.

Just then a soft rustle announced Walnut the squirrel. “Misty! What a wonderfully mellow afternoon!” he chattered.

Misty blinked her slow sleepy blinks. “Hello, Walnut,” she purred. “Wouldn’t it be simply lovely to have the softest, coziest carpet right here in the garden for a nap? A carpet so soft it feels like a cloud fallen from the sky?”

Walnut’s bright eyes twinkled. “A carpet! Oh, Misty, what a marvelous idea! But what kind of carpet would be softest?”

Misty looked at the apple tree, where soft petals had drifted down. “Fallen blossoms!” she whispered. “Pink and white petals, all soft and light, like little kisses from the flowers.”

Walnut wiggled with delight. “Brilliant! Let us make the very best blossom carpet the garden has ever seen!”

And so Misty and Walnut began their grand gathering. Misty, with her careful little paws, gently nudged the fallen petals. Walnut, with his nimble paws, gathered them up. They worked together, a gentle team, piling the blossoms into a lovely little mound near the old apple tree. The blossoms were a soft pink and pearly white swirl.

Misty settled down. “Mmm,” she purred. “It’s nice. But maybe,” she yawned, a big wide kitteny yawn, “maybe not quite soft enough for a proper, deep, sleepy nap. My tummy feels a little bit of the grass beneath.”

Walnut peeked at the pile. “You are right, Misty! It needs to be even softer! Like a cloud that has fallen from the sky! Or like a whisper made of petals!” He scanned the ground with his bright eyes. “More blossoms! We need even more blossoms!”

So they went back to their important blossom-gathering work with gentle purpose. They searched for the plumpest, softest petals. Walnut discovered extra-special pale pink ones, hidden beneath a broad leaf, that smelled like sweet dreams. Misty fluffed the growing pile, making it even more welcoming. Soon their blossom carpet was a magnificent mound of pink and white softness. It looked like a little cloud that had settled right there on the grass, waiting for a sleepy friend.

Misty yawned again, a truly massive sleepy yawn. Walnut did a little happy hop and landed with a soft thump right in the middle of the blossoms.

“Oh!” breathed Misty, her sleepy eyes widening even more. “It’s perfect! Truly, wonderfully perfect!” The soft petals tickled her nose, the gentle breeze whispered through the leaves, and the warm sunlight kissed her fur.

“Simply wonderful!” agreed Walnut, his tail doing a happy loop-the-loop. “So soft! So light!”

They snuggled down, side by side, on their super-soft blossom carpet. The sunbeams felt even gentler, like a warm hug from the sky. Misty curled into a little fluffy ball, her purr beginning to rumble softly, a low contented sound. Walnut tucked his nose under his fluffy tail, feeling safe and warm.

The garden was quiet now, a peaceful hush settling over everything. A little robin sang a soft sleepy tune, like a gentle lullaby. The leaves made a gentle rustling sound, a constant soothing whisper. Misty’s purr rumbled, low and contented. Walnut’s breathing grew slow and even.

And soon, so very soon, their eyes grew heavy, heavy, heavy. They drifted off into a lovely peaceful blossom-filled slumber, dreaming sweet soft dreams under the gentle warm sun. Everything was just right.
